content:
# 如何向网站提交比赛战绩

排名页和球员个人页的数据都来自提交上来的比赛记录。没提交的不进系统，那场球也就不计分。

## 在哪提交

站内两处入口，都指向[提交战绩页](submit.html)：

1. Ranking 页表格右上角，「积分计算规则」按钮下面的「提交战绩」按钮
2. 每个页面页脚的「提交战绩」链接

提交页上只有「打开提交表单」一个按钮，点了会在新标签页打开腾讯文档的收集表。不用登录，填完直接交。

## 收集表怎么填

| 字段 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| 日期 | 是 | 比赛当天，格式 `2026-09-12`；不能晚于今天 |
| 比赛类型 | 是 | 从下拉里选；平时约球选「普通」 |
| 赛制 | 否 | `default` / `bo3` / `bo5` / `bo7`；选 `default` 时按该类型的默认赛制处理 |
| 胜者 | 是 | 正式姓名或已登记的别名 |
| 负者 | 是 | 同上；不能和胜者填成同一个人 |
| 总比分 | 否 | 如 `3-1`，**胜者局数写在前面** |
| 逐局分数 | 否 | 如 `11-9, 8-11, 11-7`，按**胜者视角**写，先赢的局放在前面 |
| 备注 | 否 | 让分、换人之类的补充说明 |
| 你的昵称 | 否 | 方便管理员知道是谁交的 |

## 常见问题

**Q：同一天跟同一个人打了两场，能填两行吗？**

填两行。系统不会把同一天的相同对阵并成一条，两场各自计分。

**Q：多久能在排名页看到？**

管理员过段时间审一次，攒几条一起导，没有固定时间。导入发布后刷新排名页就能看到。

**Q：填错了怎么办？**

跟管理员说哪一行填错，改完重新提交。已经导进网站的行会在收集表里标「已入库」，下次导表会跳过。

**Q：收集表进不去？**

到社团 QQ 群里 @ 管理人员，把日期、胜者、负者发过去，有总比分就一起发（如 `3-1`），他会代你录入。

积分怎么算的，见[积分计算规则](detail.html?type=qa&id=q1)。

# How to Submit Match Results to the Website

The data on the Ranking page and on each player's personal page comes from submitted match records. A match that has not been submitted does not enter the system, and that match is not scored either.

## Where to submit

There are two entry points on the site, and both lead to the [match submission page](submit.html):

1. The "Submit Results" button under the "Scoring Rules" button at the top right of the Ranking page table
2. The "Submit Results" link in the footer of every page

The submission page has a single button, "Open the submission form". Clicking it opens the Tencent Docs collection form in a new tab. No login is required - just fill it in and submit.

## How to fill in the form

| Field | Required | Notes |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| Date | Yes | The day of the match, format `2026-09-12`; it cannot be later than today |
| Event type | Yes | Pick from the drop-down; choose "Normal" for a casual rally |
| Format | No | `default` / `bo3` / `bo5` / `bo7`; with `default`, the default format for that event type is used |
| Winner | Yes | The official name, or an alias that is already registered |
| Loser | Yes | Same; must not be the same person as the winner |
| Overall score | No | For example `3-1`, with the **winner's games written first** |
| Game scores | No | For example `11-9, 8-11, 11-7`, written from the **winner's perspective**, with the games won first listed first |
| Notes | No | Extra information such as handicaps or substitutions |
| Your nickname | No | So that the administrator knows who submitted the record |

## FAQ

**Q: I played two matches against the same person on the same day - can I fill in two rows?**

Fill in two rows. The system does not merge identical match-ups from the same day; each match is scored separately.

**Q: How long until it shows up on the Ranking page?**

An administrator reviews submissions every so often and imports them in batches, so there is no fixed schedule. Once the import is published, refresh the Ranking page and you will see it.

**Q: What if I made a mistake?**

Tell the administrator which row was wrong and submit it again. Rows that have already been imported are marked as done in the collection form and are skipped on the next import.

**Q: What if I cannot open the collection form?**

Mention an administrator in the club QQ group and send them the date, the winner and the loser; if you have an overall score, send that too (for example `3-1`), and they will enter it for you.

For how the points themselves are calculated, see the [scoring rules](detail.html?type=qa&id=q1).
